hintroom.level4.antechamber: Statues and plates open the throne door. A second warden stands guard!
hintroom.level4.deepdark: Dark room: everyone lights their colored brazier. Refuel at the lit braziers.
hintroom.level4.echoes: The statues, under waves of enemies! The green hero holds the cairn.
hintroom.level4.gallery: Four plates in the four corners of the frozen lake: hold them all at once!
hintroom.level4.spire: One lever per hero at the end of the four arms: pull them before they reset!
hintroom.level4.threshold: Twin statues: a hero on a plinth turns the other statue, far away.
hintroom.level4.throne: The Frost Queen awaits. Shelter behind the ice columns!
hintroom.level4.warden1: The Frost Warden hits hard: take cover behind the ice columns.
level.level4.intro.1: In the north the mountains turn white: the Frost Caverns glitter under the ice.
level.level4.intro.2: Another fragment sleeps in the depths. I can feel it beating, slow and cold.
level.level4.intro.3: Twin statues guard every door: one answers the other, at the far end.
level.level4.intro.4: Visitors? Do come in. The cold will welcome you better than I will.
level.level4.intro.5: We brought scarves, Majesty. Your statues, however, might be about to turn!
level.level4.name: The Frost Caverns
level.level4.outro.1: The Frost Queen shatters into a thousand shards. A fragment lights up in the ice.
level.level4.outro.2: I hear it... The Crystal grows stronger. But the cold barely recedes.
level.level4.outro.3: No panic: we still have spare socks. Where to next?
level.level4.outro.4: Where the rock glows red: forges burn beneath the mountain. Let us go.
objective.level4.slayer: Land 4 killing blows in the lair
room.level4.antechamber.name: The Throne Antechamber
room.level4.deepdark.name: The Blind Depths
room.level4.echoes.name: The Cavern of Echoes
room.level4.gallery.name: The Stalactite Gallery
room.level4.spire.name: The Frost Spire
room.level4.threshold.name: The Frozen Threshold
room.level4.throne.name: The Queen's Throne
room.level4.warden1.name: The Warden's Lair
sign.level4.antechamber.door: The throne door needs the aligned statues AND the guard plates held.
sign.level4.antechamber.pair: Both statues must face west (left), in the eastern chambers.
sign.level4.antechamber.plates: Guard plates, in the west: the green hero (3 players) and yellow (4) hold them.
sign.level4.antechamber.socketA: Plinth of the north-east statue: it turns the south-east statue.
sign.level4.antechamber.socketB: Plinth of the south-east statue: it turns the north-east statue.
sign.level4.deepdark.braziers: Each hero has a colored brazier at a corner of the ring: Action to light it.
sign.level4.deepdark.dark: Dark room: your torch burns down. Refuel at lit braziers (Action).
sign.level4.deepdark.door: The door opens when all four colored braziers burn.
sign.level4.deepdark.ring: Two ramps lead to the ring around the room. Do not get lost!
sign.level4.echoes.cairn: The green hero holds the central cairn for 8 s. Waves come in groups.
sign.level4.echoes.pair: Same principle, but enemies prowl: turn the statues in the middle of the fight!
sign.level4.echoes.socketA: Plinth of the north-east statue: it turns the south-west statue.
sign.level4.echoes.socketB: Plinth of the south-west statue: it turns the north-east statue.
sign.level4.echoes.south: Both statues must face south (down), at opposite ends of the cavern.
sign.level4.gallery.door: The ice portcullis stays up once opened. Beyond it, a last guard.
sign.level4.gallery.lake: The frozen lake is impassable: go around it, guardians are waiting.
sign.level4.gallery.plates: Each plate has a hero color, in the four corner chambers.
sign.level4.spire.arms: The arms are long: call out, then pull together before the levers reset.
sign.level4.spire.door: The north-east door stays open once raised.
sign.level4.spire.levers: One lever per hero: blue west, red north, green east, yellow south.
sign.level4.spire.window: Each lever resets after 25 s: pull them almost together.
sign.level4.threshold.door: The door opens when both statues face north. Guide each other!
sign.level4.threshold.north: Both statues must face north (up). One plinth per statue, in opposite wings.
sign.level4.threshold.socketA: Plinth of the north-west statue: it turns the south-east statue.
sign.level4.threshold.socketB: Plinth of the south-east statue: it turns the north-west statue.
sign.level4.threshold.twins: Twin statues: on a plinth, Action turns the OTHER statue a quarter turn.
sign.level4.throne.warning: The exit is sealed: the Queen must fall and all four objectives be done.
sign.level4.warden1.cover: Ice columns stop the shards. The yellow hero lands 4 killing blows.
sign.level4.warden1.warden: The Frost Warden hits hard and charges. Dodge right after his swing!
